title: Five Island & Seven Island
subtitle: Rocket Warehouse and the Sapphire, Togepi egg, Lost Cave, Trainer Tower, Tanoby Ruins

steps.text: Five Isle Meadow (south of Five Island): trainers and items on the way to the Rocket Warehouse.
Rocket Warehouse: the door needs both passwords (from Mt. Ember and Icefall Cave). Spinner tiles inside; beat the Rocket Admins and Scientist Gideon in the northeast room.
Gideon hands over the Sapphire after losing.
Deliver the Sapphire to Celio on One Island: the Network Machine is fixed, enabling trades with Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald and opening Cerulean Cave (chapter 19).
Memorial Pillar (Surf south of Five Island): leave a Lemonade at the grave to receive TM42 Facade from the mourning trainer.
Water Labyrinth (Surf west of Five Island): the man on the island gives a Togepi Egg if your lead Pokémon has high friendship. One-time.
Resort Gorgeous (north): rich trainers; Selphy's butler asks you to find her in the Lost Cave.
Lost Cave: a looping maze. From the entrance go up, right, up, left (Selphy is in the room with Lady Selphy); wrong turns loop back. Items hide in dead ends (Silk Scarf, Sacred Ash, Max Revive).
Back at Resort Gorgeous, Selphy invites you to her house: show her the Pokémon she asks for and she gives Luxury Balls (or rarer items). Repeatable.
Seven Island: Swords Dance Move Tutor (once).
Trainer Tower (north of Seven Island): timed challenge in Single, Double, Knockout and Mixed modes. Clear rewards: Up-Grade, Dragon Scale, Metal Coat, King's Rock — the trade-evolution items.
Canyon Entrance and Sevault Canyon (south): the toughest route trainers in the game, good for leveling. Rock Smash rocks and Strength boulders.
Sevault Canyon house: watch the Chansey Dance and pick up the Lucky Punch (item ball) inside.
Tanoby Key (cave at the south end of the canyon): push the seven boulders onto the seven switches. That unlocks Unown in the seven Tanoby Ruins chambers (Surf south of the canyon).
